``` {r}
rm(list = ls())

library(CSTools)

Auto_Claims <- read.csv("Auto_Claims.CSV")

split <-  sample.split (Auto_Claim$claim_amount, SplitRatio = .7)
train_data <- subset(Auto_Claims, split == TRUE)
test_data <- subset(Auto_Claims, split == FALSE)

train_data |> ggplot(aes(x = driving_years, y= claim_amount)) +
  geom_point


mode1OSL <-  lm (claim_amount - driving_years, data = train_data)

summary(mode1OSL)


library(stargazer)
stargazer(mode1OSL, type = "text")
```
